## Finalize/sink plan for this run's record location
The live run folder `kaola-workflow/bundle-1054/` lives at the MAIN root and is tracked on main since 34f634d4 (an earlier owner-requested durability commit); the branch does not track it. The finalize transaction mirrors main → worktree (first_sync, receipt written), archives from the worktree, verifies the copy, and deletes BOTH live copies. To keep the sink's clean-main precondition honest, the tracked live folder is untracked on main (`git rm -r --cached`, one bookkeeping commit) immediately before finalize, so the archive commit on the branch is the folder's only tracked home afterwards; the record bytes never leave disk until the archive copy is verified. Recorded here so the sequence is reviewable.

After #1054's normal finalization, archive, sink/merge, closure, and acceptance: cut a formal release (version chosen by the repository's existing release process and version rules), publish the GitHub Release and tag, synchronize origin/main and the local main checkout, then install every applicable local runtime with `./install-all.sh` and verify with `./install-all.sh --check`.
